$comment: Pod power-level rules: two-tier shared-point-budget system. Anchored to the 36 precon decks (2024-2026) in out/precon_decks. Consumed by scripts/tier_rules.py. Dials are computed by scripts/power_metrics.py compute_deck_stats().

extra_turns.flag_if_over_zero: Extra-turn effects need explicit table justification (one-shot spells only).

combos.note: Included infinite combos per Commander Spellbook, every combo counted separately (no dedup by shared cards); template requirements (e.g. 'a creature with persist') must actually be filled by a deck card, so partial packages don't count. First 2 free (precon-normal: 11/36 precons ship complete combos). Each combo beyond: 2-card +3, 3-card +2, 4+ +1 — free slots absorb the most expensive combos first; template pieces count toward combo size. Calibration: Living Energy lands in Tier 2, the honest outcome for the comboiest precon; Witherbloom Pestilence returned to Tier 1 once template checking showed its 'combos' need a persist creature it doesn't run.

hard_bans.max_card_price_note: No single card over 30 EUR (cheapest Cardmarket printing). Exceeding requires explicit table approval, outside these rules.
hard_bans.banned_cards_note: Curated lists, extend as the pod meets new cards. true_fast_mana: repeatable/permanent explosive mana only — one-shot rituals (Dark Ritual etc.) are allowed and count on the fast-mana dial when cmc<=2. extra_turn_recursion: extra turns may never be repeatable.

conditionals.description: A game changer must be the deck's only luxury: no elevated price bands alongside it.
Tutors turn any strong card into multiple virtual copies: no game changers alongside tutors.
Tutors turn a 2-card combo into every-game consistency: with any infinite combo, no unconditional tutors.
Fast mana and free spells stack multiplicatively: having BOTH above baseline costs extra budget.

overflow_note: Beyond a dial's last priced step, every extra unit costs +1 more point — points never stop counting. No per-dial forbidden zones; only the tier budgets decide, except dials marked forbidden and the hard bans.
